capture_method: Actual local terminal session. Commands were typed into a real conhost.exe window running pwsh via WriteConsoleInput; raw PNGs are unedited PrintWindow images of that window; buffer text was read back with ReadConsoleOutputCharacter.

terminal.psreadline: PredictionSource None (no history suggestions on screen); HistorySaveStyle SaveNothing
terminal.prompt: PS <folder>> — a custom prompt that hides the long absolute path and logs each history entry to prompt-log.jsonl; it prints nothing else

re-run: the first attempt of this capture typed the same commands but crashed after the window closed (evidence/ folder missing when copying project-diff.txt); its raw PNGs and logs were set aside undelivered and this capture started from a fresh harness copy
